business_scope.primary_industry_name: Bonded Warehouse Operations in Customs Free Trade Zones

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law, French civil law heritage, and customary law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Vanuatu-China Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement
Vanuatu-United Kingdom Bilateral Investment Treaty (historical framework)
PACER Plus Trade Agreement (limited investment provisions)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or national passport office in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization (for non-Hague Convention origin jurisdictions)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank of the beneficial owner/shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization (if required by bank jurisdiction)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or registrar of the shareholder's jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, and authorized signatories against the Vanuatu Domestic Sanctions List, UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, FATF blacklist/grey lists, World Bank Listing, and the VFSC Enforcement Database. Enhanced due diligence is required for politically exposed persons (PEPs) and any jurisdiction identified by FATF; independent verification and risk-based enhanced monitoring are compulsory.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) International Company Name Reservation and Online Search Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: International Company names must be in Roman script using English-language characters; names in Bislama, French, or English characters are acceptable but must be distinct and not offensive. Transliteration into Latin script is mandatory if a desired name contains non-Roman characters; the VFSC reserves the right to require a suffix denoting 'International Company' or 'IC' to distinguish under the International Companies Act.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant must file a written appeal with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Registrar within 14 days of the rejection notice, accompanied by legal submissions showing compliance with the International Companies Act and proposed consent letters from the relevant ministry if a sensitive word is justifiable. If the Registrar denies the appeal, the applicant may apply to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu for judicial review within 30 days of the denial. A fresh name reservation application with a modified name is permitted immediately.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is permissible for the registered office requirement only if the virtual office provider is a licensed VFSC-registered registered agent maintaining a physical address in Port Vila; however, a bonded warehouse in a free trade zone requires a genuine physical depot location and cannot rely solely on a virtual office for operational substance.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High - approximately 70% to 85% likelihood of unannounced physical inspection within the first year of license activation due to the bonded warehouse and customs free trade zone regulatory requirements.

International Company incorporation filing fee (standard share capital, no minimum capital)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act, 2011 (Vanuatu), as amended, particularly Sections 12 (Incorporation), 18 (Registered Office), and 34 (Directors); supplemented by Companies (Fees) Regulation under the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act [Cap 243].
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry Division, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation of an International Company (Form IC-01)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement; subscriber may declare share capital of any amount, and no escrow account is required for an International Company under the International Companies Act, 2011.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscription of shares set forth in the incorporation documents is hereby ratified and accepted; RESOLVED that the registered office of the Company be fixed at the address notified to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, and that the registered agent maintain such office; RESOLVED that the persons named below be and are hereby appointed as Directors and (as applicable) the Company Secretary to hold office until the next annual general meeting; FURTHER RESOLVED that the Directors are authorised to execute all documents and take all actions necessary to obtain any trading, customs, environmental, and occupational licenses required for the Company's bonded warehouse operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry (online portal: VFSC e-Registries)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reserve application through the VFSC e-Registries portal, specifying the proposed International Company name (e.g., “[Bonded Operations] Ltd”). The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered entity. VFSC will issue a name reservation certificate valid for 90 days.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, revise the proposed name and resubmit within 5 business days; an appeal may be made to VFSC in writing within 14 days of refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry / accredited registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the Memorandum and Articles of Association as prescribed by the International Companies Act, 2011, and verify the subscriber shareholding. Documents must be notarised by a Vanuatu notary or an authorised foreign notary with apostille certification.
required_dossiers: Consent of registered agent and director(s)
Proof of identity and residential address of subscribers
Notarised statutory declaration of compliant incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC queries the application, provide supplementary explanations or corrected documents within 10 business days; VFSC will resume processing after the deficiency is cured.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Finance Division via bank transfer or online payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the state filing fee of USD 350 plus the registered agent annual fee to the VFSC designated account. Retain proof of payment referencing the application reference number.
required_dossiers: Proof of wire transfer or payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Overpayment or missing payment is reconciled by VFSC treasury; underpayment triggers a 14-day cure notice before file closure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review of the application, VFSC registers the company and issues a Certificate of Incorporation. The registered agent is notified electronically and the official certificate is couriered to the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is not issued within SLA, escalate to VFSC Registrar directly; any technical errors in the certificate are corrected via a Certificate of Amendment application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting minutes as per the pro-forma resolution; adopt the registered office, appoint directors, officers and company secretary; open a corporate bank account with a Vanuatu licensed bank or an approved international bank; obtain company seal (optional).
required_dossiers: Registered office acceptance letter from agent
Notice of appointment of officers filed with VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If officer appointment filings are rejected, resubmit corrected Form IC-06 with updated signatures and board attestation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Service (CIRS) in coordination with the Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce; industrial zone administration under the Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Bonded Warehouse Operating License (Customs Form BW-01) under the Customs Act [Cap 241] and Free Trade Zone Regulations

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Environment and Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 – Environmental Impact Assessment Registration (low to moderate risk); a full EIA is not required for bonded warehouse operations with no hazardous processes, but a site-specific Environmental Compliance Notice must be obtained.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Vanuatu National Environmental Standards: wastewater discharged to municipal system must meet total suspended solids ≤ 50 mg/L; no uncontrolled release of volatile organic compounds (VOCs); hazardous waste storage shall comply with the Waste Management Regulations under the Environment Management and Conservation Act [Cap 283].

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: State Law Office Fire Safety Division and Vanuatu Occupational Safety and Health Service: fire safety certification with emergency exit plan and fire suppression system approval; structural load inspection certificate for warehouse racking; workplace clearance certifying safe material handling and hazard communication.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC) – Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila. Principal platforms: ASYCUDA World customs single window and VRC online inland-revenue registration/return portal (gov.vu domain).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Incorporate the International Company (IC) with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) under the International Companies Act 1992 (Cap 222); no minimum paid-in capital is required and 100% foreign ownership is permitted. 2) Through the licensed registered agent, obtain the Certificate of Incorporation, registered-office consent, and current good-standing certificate. 3) Apply to VRC for VAT registration once taxable turnover reaches or is likely to exceed VUV 10,000,000 in any 12-month period; voluntary registration is available below the threshold; the application file includes the incorporation certificate, VFSC good-standing certificate, director and shareholder register, VIPA foreign-investment approval, any required business licence, proof of a physical Vanuatu place of business, and bank confirmation. 4) Register as importer/exporter in ASYCUDA World and obtain a Customs Bonded Warehouse Licence under the Customs Act (Cap 231), which requires premises approval, a fidelity bond or bank guarantee, and an approved electronic stock-control system. 5) If hiring local staff, register as an employer with the Vanuatu National Provident Fund (VNPF) for statutory contributions; note that Vanuatu currently imposes no income tax and no PAYE withholding registration. 6) Maintain the IC's non-resident conduct rules, including the prohibition on trading with Vanuatu residents and on holding Vanuatu land (outside narrow statutory concessions), to preserve the statutory exemption.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone – the IC is a statutory exempt international entity: Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, inheritance tax, or gift tax, and the bonded-depot IC therefore operates outside the domestic income-tax net. For indirect tax, only supplies made in Vanuatu for domestic consumption are in scope; bonded-warehouse storage and export-related supplies are zero-rated and goods remain suspended from customs duty and VAT until entered for home consumption.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box entity classification and no hybrid-mismatch elections exist because Vanuatu has no income-tax legislation. The available elections are indirect-tax mechanisms: (a) voluntary VAT registration for sub-threshold taxable activities under the Value Added Tax Act (Cap 249); (b) customs bond suspension election, whereby goods brought into the approved bonded depot or free-trade-zone area are treated as not entered for home consumption and import duty plus 15% VAT are deferred until removal; (c) documented election to apply 0% VAT to export supplies and services connected with exported goods; and (d) appointment of a tax representative or licensed customs agent for filing and declaration purposes where the operator is non-resident.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) – Value Added Tax Act [Cap 249], supplemented by customs duty and excise under the Customs Act [Cap 231]
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 10,000,000 annual taxable turnover (effective 1 July 2022, raised from VUV 3,500,000). Registration is compulsory once the 12-month forecast or actual threshold is reached; voluntary registration is available below the threshold. A separate Customs Bonded Warehouse Licence is required for bonded-d depot operations irrespective of VAT turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu does not currently mandate real-time e-invoicing, fiscal clearance APIs, or digital stamping. Customs processing is digital through ASYCUDA World, with electronic declaration lodgement, selectivity, and risk-based inspection. VAT returns are filed monthly through the VRC online portal. Bonded-depot operators must maintain ASYCUDA-linked electronic stock and entry/exit records and lodge all entries through licensed customs agents; invoices must satisfy the content requirements of the VAT Act but no government clearance stamp or integrity token is imposed.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to: (1) goods physically exported from Vanuatu within the statutory period, including goods removed from a bonded depot or designated free-trade-zone area for outward shipment; (2) services supplied directly in connection with exported goods or foreign-going ships and aircraft, such as bonded storage, handling, and international freight; (3) international carriage of passengers or goods; and (4) services supplied to non-residents for use wholly outside Vanuatu. If bonded goods are released into the domestic market instead, 15% VAT plus applicable customs duty is payable on the value at release.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration lodged and validated in ASYCUDA World
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing carriage to a foreign port or airport
Port or airport outturn certificate / customs departure record proving physical exit from Vanuatu
Zero-rated commercial invoice identifying the non-resident buyer and INCOTERMS
Inward remittance certificate or bank foreign-currency receipt evidencing payment from abroad
Bonded warehouse entry/exit stock register in approved format and any applicable re-export permit
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRC may audit and reopen assessments for up to three years, extended to six years where fraud is alleged. If the mandatory documentation bundle is incomplete or inconsistent, the zero-rating is reversed and output VAT is assessed at 15% on the full consideration, with statutory interest and late-payment or shortfall penalties; wilful evasion attracts additional fines and criminal prosecution. The Commissioner may suspend or revoke the bonded warehouse licence and recommend VFSC or VIPA licence action against the operator. Knowingly falsifying export documentation constitutes an offence under the VAT Act and Customs Act, with criminal fines and imprisonment for responsible officers or directors, and may expose the enterprise to adverse findings through Vanuatu's exchange-of-information commitments with tax treaty and FATF partners.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) – the national central bank and designated authority under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 62], responsible for foreign exchange policy, payment system oversight, and bank supervision; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) separately regulates International Companies and the financial services sector.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu vatu (VUV) is freely convertible for both current and capital account transactions. Vanuatu maintains an open, notification-based exchange-control regime rather than a prior-approval regime, and International Companies operating in the free trade zone/bonded depot space face no local restriction on profit repatriation, dividend distribution, capital withdrawal, or settlement of trade obligations. Practical convertibility frictions are limited to the shallowness of the offshore VUV market and to correspondent-bank due diligence, not to Vanuatu regulatory prohibitions. For current account items, authorised commercial banks are permitted to sell and purchase foreign exchange against VUV; for capital account items, no standing RBV licence is required, although statistical reporting is expected. There is no capital gains tax, withholding tax, or income tax on an International Company, which further simplifies remittance mechanics.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or repatriation timeline applies to export receipts in Vanuatu. The Exchange Control Act [Cap. 62] does not impose conversion ratios, minimum hold periods, or prefixed surrender rates for goods or services exported from the customs free trade zone. Exporters, including bonded depot operators with International Company status, may retain foreign currency proceeds in offshore accounts or in foreign-currency accounts held onshore, at their election. The only administrative obligation is the accurate reporting of cross-border transactions through an authorised dealer for RBV balance-of-payments statistics and, separately, customs declaration of the physical movement of goods to the Vanuatu Customs and Border Compliance Service.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow / Operational VUV and USD Account for Bonded Depot Treasury
Operational VUV/USD/AUD Account, Customs Bond Sub-Account
Operational VUV and Foreign Currency Account for Trade Settlement
Operational VUV Account with Correspondent USD Clearing Facility

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. Vanuatu does not maintain a separate e-money institution (EMI) licence class, and offshore digital EMIs are not passportable into Vanuatu. Only RBV-licensed commercial banks may take deposits or provide payment/clearing services to an International Company in the ordinary course. A non-resident digital EMI cannot open a local settlement account or provide hosted payment services holding client funds without a local RBV banking licence, which in practice requires a physical presence in Port Vila, prudential capital, and full AML/CFT infrastructure. Digital EMIs may be used only as an ancillary payment-information layer, provided all actual clearing is effected through a local authorised bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is generally mandated for first-time corporate clients. At least one executive director, or a duly appointed authorised signatory holding a notarised power-of-attorney, must attend an in-person interview at the Port Vila branch. Pure remote onboarding is not permitted under prevailing bank policy for a cross-border International Company with non-resident shareholders; the bank requires the signatory to present original passport, proof of residential address, and a source-of-funds narrative. A registered agent or VFSC-licensed introducer may supplement, but not replace, the direct interview requirement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: VFSC-registered International Company in a zero-tax jurisdiction with non-resident directors and minimal physical footprint in Vanuatu.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing from VFSC; register of directors and registered-agent acknowledgement; completed UBO declaration; notarised passports and proof-of-residence for all directors and shareholders; board resolution appointing signatories and defining bonded-depot operational authority; legal opinion from a Vanuatu counsel confirming valid IC registration, absence of vanity taxation, and that the entity is not shell/front-monies risk.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bonded warehouse/free-trade-zone model involving goods that move without entering the domestic customs territory, creating invoice-and-transport opacity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Customs bonded-warehouse licence or free-trade-zone authorisation; depot concession/lease; customs inventory bond and stock reconciliation records; warehouse-management-system logs; underlying trade contracts with Incoterms, purchase orders, commercial invoices, packing lists, and bills of lading; due-diligence file on every material supplier and counterparty.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments to or from third-party related entities in high-risk or offshore jurisdictions, triggering enhanced sanctions and source-of-funds scrutiny.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified ultimate-beneficiary identity, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements; OFAC, EU, UN, and national sanctions screening reports; PEP checks; tax-residence certificates of owners; board-approved treasury policy; supporting commercial contracts and customs evidence demonstrating a real bonded-depot trade; reference letter from a VFSC-licensed registered agent or a reputable professional introducer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large round-sum capital injections or frequent in-and-out wire movements inconsistent with stated authorised capital.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Treasury narrative and cash-flow projection; board resolutions authorising each capital contribution, escrow deposit, and disbursement tier; audited or management financial statements; customs-turnover report on warehouse cycle times; prescribed-form AML transaction monitoring and, where applicable, an internal suspicious-transaction assessment confirming genuine trade purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Legacy International Company history of bearer shares, unrecorded ownership, or late VFSC filings.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered-agent certificate confirming the company is governed by the International Companies Act and that any historical bearer instruments have been converted, cancelled, and are not outstanding; full register of members maintained at the registered office; VFSC confirmation of current statutory filings; signed declarations from each shareholder confirming ultimate beneficial ownership and lawfulness of funds.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The compliant routing for inbound capital is an international SWIFT credit transfer (MT103 or MT202) from the investor’s bank to the International Company’s operating or capital-escrow account at a RBV-licensed commercial bank in Port Vila. The SWIFT message must bear the exact legal name of the International Company, the purpose code or narrative agreed with the receiving bank under RBV balance-of-payments statistical instructions, and a clear reference to ‘equity contribution – bonded depot capital injection’. The remitter should be the registered shareholder or the named intra-group lender; if a third-party remitter is unavoidable, a fully executed assignment, loan agreement, or written declaration must be pre-approved by the bank to prevent rejection. The receiving bank should receive an advance remittance advice containing the board resolution, share subscription/allocation document, source-of-funds declaration, customs free-zone licence, and evidence that the funds are not connected to a known money-laundering or sanctions predicate.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements are cleared primarily through SWIFT MT103 for direct supplier and trade payments. For documentary trade settlement, the bank issues commercial letters of credit through the SWIFT MT700 series (issue, amendment, reimbursement authorization), and documentary collections are processed under the SWIFT MT4xx series as advised by the receiving bank. Inbound VUV-denominated settlement from domestic trade is cleared through the local interbank clearing and RBV settlement system, while foreign-currency outflows are settled through the bank’s correspondent network. Bonded depot operations should segregate disbursement categories — customs duties and bond maintenance, freight and logistics, supplier payments, and intra-group fees — so that AML monitoring matches each outgoing wire to an underlying warehouse transaction and the AXIL/export documentation set.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Spot VUV/USD and VUV/AUD purchase and sale through an RBV-licensed authorised dealer, physically deliverable onshore.
Outright forward contracts for documented trade settlements and inventory replenishment, tenor normally up to 12 months and subject to dealer limits.
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) executed offshore with a reputable counterparty, settling in USD, because the offshore VUV market is not fully deliverable.
Cross-currency interest-rate and cross-currency principal swaps between VUV and USD/AUD where the authorised bank can source liquidity and the hedge is tied to real trade or funding exposure.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: International Company Annual Return (VFSC Form AR) including declaration of continued tax-exempt status and absence of prohibited Vanuatu-sourced domestic trading
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - Companies Registrar, International Companies Section
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 calendar days after each anniversary of the International Company's incorporation date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of up to VUV 25,000 (approx. USD 210); loss of Certificate of Good Standing; failure to file for two consecutive years exposes the International Company to administrative strike-off and dissolution; the registered agent is jointly liable for ensuring timely filing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Declaration and confirmation of Beneficial Ownership Register particulars
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC - Confidential Beneficial Ownership Register maintained under the Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Act 2020
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Lodged together with the Annual Return within 30 days of the incorporation anniversary; any share transfer, share issuance, or change of control must be notified to VFSC within 30 days of the underlying event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Civil and criminal monetary penalties imposed on the company and each defaulting officer for late, false, or incomplete beneficial ownership filings; VFSC may impose share-transfer restrictions and initiate strike-off proceedings for persistent non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Bonded Warehouse / Free Trade Zone Operator Licence annual renewal declaration and activity return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Customs Service (Ministry of Finance) and the Free Trade Zone administering authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Renewal application submitted no later than the annual licence anniversary date per the customs bonded-warehouse licence terms; activity return filed within 30 days after each 31 December fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Exposure to customs duty penalties up to the full amount of suspended duties; licence suspension for arrears exceeding 60 days; revocation for non-renewal; unauthorised continued bonded operations constitute a customs offence carrying fines and risk of goods forfeiture.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit applies only where the International Company qualifies as a 'large company' under the Vanuatu Companies Act 2022, determined by exceeding any two of three thresholds: annual gross revenue above VUV 100 million (approx. USD 830,000), total assets above VUV 100 million, or more than 100 employees. Below these thresholds, the International Company is exempt from statutory audit and VFSC does not require lodgement of financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as issued by the IASB; the Vanuatu Companies Act 2022 requires accounting records that reflect a true and fair view; no separate Vanuatu national GAAP applies to International Companies; financial records may be maintained in USD with VUV translation notes for customs reconciliation purposes.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The International Company must maintain a Beneficial Ownership Register at its registered office in Vanuatu recording each beneficial owner's full name, date of birth, nationality, residential address, and percentage of ownership or control. An annual confirmation declaration certifying the accuracy and currency of the register must be lodged with VFSC together with the Annual Return. Every share transfer, issuance, or change in control requires a register update and VFSC notification within 30 days of the event. The register is confidential and non-public, accessible only to VFSC and authorised law-enforcement authorities.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (shareholders ledger with outstanding shareholdings)
Minute Book of board and shareholder resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 - 900 per annum (Vanuatu registered agent plus registered office, inclusive of statutory register custody, company secretarial services, and VFSC liaison)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,000 - 8,000 only if the large-company audit threshold is triggered; otherwise USD 0 (statutorily audit-exempt); optional customs inventory reconciliation review USD 1,500 - 3,500

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax; International Companies (ICs) are absolutely exempt from all income, profits, and withholding taxes under Section 137 of the International Companies Act (Cap. 222).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory 0% effective rate on all offshore income and distributions. ICs benefit from exemption from capital gains tax, stamp duty, business licence tax, and VAT on offshore business. The 12.5% VAT applies only to onshore taxable supplies by a VAT-registered entity; an exempt IC operating solely within the Free Trade Zone bonded depot is outside the Vanuatu VAT net. No tax certificate or annual tax return is required for income tax purposes.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists for ICs. The sole mandatory recurring filing is the VFSC Annual Return, submitted by the licensed registered agent through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) e-Registry secure portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The VFSC Annual Return and the annual government licence fee are due on the anniversary of incorporation (treated as the fiscal year-end); a one-month statutory grace period applies before late filing surcharges accrue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name, VFSC registration number, IC class, date of incorporation, registered office, and the name of the registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No Vanuatu tax identification number is required; the non-resident beneficial owner provides identification and proof of non-resident status to the agent, who completes the form.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification by the licensed Vanuatu registered agent that the company chart, directors, and registered office are correct and that the annual fee has been computed correctly.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident IC cannot self-file; the registered agent is the statutory filer and must hold a valid power of attorney.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part C - Share Capital and Directors Register
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of issued share capital, subscriber details, shareholder list, and director roster as held in the agent's statutory records.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors and shareholders are permitted; nominee arrangements are lawful provided the ultimate beneficial owner information is accessible to the VFSC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Attestation whether the IC holds a Certificate of Tax Exemption and confirmation that it has not carried on business with Vanuatu residents outside the permitted Free Trade Zone bonded depot scope.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach a copy of the tax certificate if previously issued; a non-resident-owned IC operating purely in the FTZ is automatically exempt without applying for a certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part E - Economic Substance Return Cross-Reference
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tick-box confirmation that the separate VFSC Economic Substance Return has been or will be filed for any relevant activity, including distribution and service centre operations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent must file the ESR declaration before the same anniversary deadline; this is not an income tax return but a substance attestation.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a surcharge equal to 100% of the annual licence fee plus a daily penalty of VUV 500. Persistent default beyond 12 months leads to strike-off, dissolution, and escheat of assets to the State. The registered agent faces administrative fines up to VUV 200,000 and licence suspension for knowingly filing false particulars.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax, no branch remittance tax, and no secondary withholding tax on distributions from an International Company to non-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreements (DTAs); relief is statutory rather than treaty-based. To evidence exemption for foreign tax credit purposes, the shareholder should: (1) obtain the VFSC Certificate of Tax Exemption for the IC; (2) obtain a Certificate of Residence from the shareholder's home jurisdiction; and (3) submit both to the foreign revenue authority. No Vanuatu withholding tax return or TRC submission is required because the source remittance is exempt at source.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: 0% withholding on cross-border royalties and 0% on debt interest paid to non-residents. No treaty rates apply due to the absence of DTAs. Foreign competent authorities may verify beneficial ownership via Vanuatu's Tax Information Exchange Agreements and the OECD Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory Local File or Master File threshold exists because the IC pays no corporate income tax; transfer pricing documentation is not a compliance trigger in Vanuatu. However, every IC conducting a relevant activity must file the annual Economic Substance Return without any minimum revenue threshold. If the IC belongs to an MNE group, Country-by-Country Reporting applies only when group consolidated revenue exceeds EUR 750 million (approximately VUV 95.2 billion) under the CbC/MCAA framework.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Economic Substance Regulations Act 2022 (ESR Act) and VFSC guidelines apply to all Vanuatu ICs. The bonded depot falls within 'distribution and service centre' as a relevant activity. Substance is demonstrated by: (a) meetings of directors and management held in Vanuatu; (b) adequate physical premises, including the customs-bonded warehousing facility; (c) local employees proportionate to activity; and (d) local operating expenditure. The registered agent files the confidential ESR return annually. Failure results in penalties and potential strike-off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Illegal Domestic Market Diversion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Free Trade Zone bonded depot to divert duty-unpaid and VAT-exempt goods into the Vanuatu domestic market; false warehouse records concealing removals; conducting prohibited trade with Vanuatu residents in breach of the IC's non-resident condition.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Cancellation of the Certificate of Tax Exemption and loss of IC status; under the Customs Act (Cap. 149), forfeiture of duty-unpaid goods and conveyances, penal assessment of 100%-300% of evaded duty, and fines up to VUV 2,000,000 per unlawful removal; revocation of the bonded warehouse licence and FTZ approval.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The court may pierce the corporate veil: directors and controlling beneficial owners are jointly and severally liable for evaded customs duty and VAT; criminal penalties reach VUV 2,000,000 fines and imprisonment up to 7 years; directors may be disqualified from managing any Vanuatu company for 5 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a mailbox or shared agent address with no local bonded warehouse premises, no local personnel, and offshore board minutes; failing to file the annual ESR return or misclassifying the depot as a pure equity-holding entity to avoid substance requirements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the ESR Act 2022: penalty up to VUV 1,000,000 plus VUV 100,000 per month of continuing breach; the VFSC may strike off the IC, report the non-resident parent to its home tax authority, and disqualify the registered agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly file false substance declarations are personally liable to a maximum fine of VUV 5,000,000 and 2 years' imprisonment; a foreign tax authority may attribute all bonded-warehouse profits to the foreign parent, exposing directors to foreign civil restitution and travel bans.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / CFT Violation and Trade-Based Money Laundering
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Exploiting high-volume bonded depot flows to launder proceeds through fictitious warehouse warrants, double invoicing, phantom transit, or commodity mispricing; accepting cash or bearer instruments above USD 10,000 without currency reporting; operating the logistics business without customer due diligence on non-resident traders.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu's AML/CFT and Proceeds of Crime legislation imposes corporate fines up to VUV 10,000,000, freezing orders, confiscation of bonded goods, and cancellation of the FTZ operating licence; the IC may be placed into compulsory liquidation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Beneficial owners and directors who authorise trade-based money laundering face indictable offences with fines up to VUV 5,000,000 and imprisonment up to 10 years; courts may order asset confiscation, passport surrender, and unconditional travel bans, defeating the corporate veil.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Customs / Free Trade Zone Bonded Depot Non-Compliance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain bonded stock records and physical inventory counts; unauthorised removal of goods without Customs clearance; issuing false re-export certificates; sub-leasing the bonded area without approval; disposal of goods without a duty-paid release certificate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Assessment of arrears duty and 12.5% VAT on every unreconciled removal, plus a surcharge of 20%-100% of the goods' value; Customs may seize and auction the inventory, revoke the bonded warehouse licence, and prosecute false declarations with corporate fines up to VUV 250,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Operational directors and the licensed warehouse custodian are personally liable for duties on short-shipped goods; each responsible officer faces fines up to VUV 750,000 or imprisonment up to 3 years, and courts may order civil restitution equal to the full revenue loss to the State.
